values: 召唤梦境催眠所有敌人，使其每秒受到伤害。
Tasi summons a dream to hypnotize all enemies, causing them to take damage each second.
召唤梦境持续3.5 + 0.5秒，使所有敌人进入“催眠”状态，被“催眠”的目标无法行动且每秒受到70% + 12% ATK伤害。
Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + 0.5s, hypnotizing all enemies. Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take 70% + 12% ATK damage per second.
被“催眠”的目标每秒受到伤害提升至80% + 12% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 80% + 12% ATK.
被“催眠”的目标每秒受到伤害提升至90% + 12% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 90% + 12% ATK.
被“催眠”的目标每秒受到伤害提升至100% + 12% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 100% + 12% ATK.
被“催眠”的目标每秒受到伤害提升至110% + 12% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 110% + 12% ATK.
消耗生命值对周围敌人造成伤害和眩晕，并飞向远处敌人再次造成伤害和眩晕。
Tasi consumes HP to deal damage and stun nearby enemies, then flies to a distant enemy to deal damage and stun again.
消耗自身当前10%生命值，对自身周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成相当于消耗生命值110% + 10%的伤害并使其眩晕0.5秒（伤害量不低于60% ATK），随后飞向距离最远的敌人身边再次对自身周围1格范围内的敌人施加该效果，单次技能对同一名敌人造成的第二次伤害只造成原伤害量的50%。

Tasi consumes 10% of her current HP to deal damage equal to 110% + 10% of her consumed HP to adjacent enemies, stunning them for 0.5s. The damage dealt will be no less than 60% ATK. She then flies to the farthest enemy and applies the same effect to adjacent enemies. However, the second hit on the same enemy will only deal 50% of the original damage.
伤害提高至生命消耗量的120% + 10%。
Increases damage to 120% + 10% of her consumed HP.
伤害提高至生命消耗量的130% + 10%。
Increases damage to 130% + 10% of her consumed HP.
伤害提高至生命消耗量的140% + 10%。
Increases damage to 140% + 10% of her consumed HP.
每当损失一定生命值后化为“梦蝶”，持续恢复生命并对周围敌人造成伤害。
Tasi transforms into a butterfly when she loses a certain amount of HP. In this form, she recovers HP while dealing damage to nearby enemies.
每当自身累计失去50% HP生命值后，躲入梦境变为“梦蝶”形态。“梦蝶”形态下自身处于无敌状态，每秒恢复120% + 10% ATK生命值并对周围1格范围内的敌人造成45% + 5% ATK伤害，持续3秒。本技能在同一场战斗中最多释放2次。

Tasi enters her dream realm and transforms into a butterfly upon losing 50% HP HP. In this form, she becomes invincible, recovering 120% + 10% ATK HP per second while dealing 45% + 5% ATK damage to adjacent enemies. This effect lasts for 3s, and Tasi can cast this skill up to 2 times in one battle.
“梦蝶”形态下每秒造成伤害提高至50% + 5% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 50% + 5% ATK.
“梦蝶”形态下每秒造成伤害提高至55% + 5% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 55% + 5% ATK.
“梦蝶”形态下每秒造成伤害提高至60% + 5% ATK。
Increases damage per second to 60% + 5% ATK.
提高自身攻击力，终极技能持续期间进一步提高攻击力。
Tasi increases her ATK and gains an additional increase while Eternal Dreamscape is active.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升9%。释放“永恒梦境”后，在梦境持续时间内额外提升6%攻击力。
Tasi increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 6% ATK while the dream lasts.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%。释放“永恒梦境”后，在梦境持续时间内额外提升8%攻击力。
Tasi increases her ATK by 12% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 8% ATK while the dream lasts.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升15%。释放“永恒梦境”后，在梦境持续时间内额外提升10%攻击力。
Tasi increases her ATK by 15% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 10% ATK while the dream lasts.
释放终极技能后获得急速并且受到伤害减少，并能更快释放技能“梦灵化身”。
Tasi gains Haste and reduces damage taken after casting Eternal Dreamscape. Additionally, she can cast Dream Dance more quickly.
塔西在释放终极技能“永恒梦境”后的5秒内，获得70点急速并且受到伤害减少90%，使用技能“梦灵化身”不受冷却时间限制，并且不再消耗生命值（造成伤害时视为消耗了10%当前生命值），并且会优先选择距离最远的处于“催眠”状态的敌人释放。

Tasi gains 70 Haste and reduces damage taken by 90% for 5s after casting Eternal Dreamscape. During this time, Dream Dance no longer costs Tasi's HP to cast and has no cooldown. Its damage counts as if Tasi had consumed 10% of her current HP, and she will prioritize targeting the farthest hypnotized enemy.
塔西释放终极技能“永恒梦境”后获得急速提高至100点。
Gains 100 Haste after casting Eternal Dreamscape.
技能“梦灵化身”对处于“催眠”状态的敌人造成伤害时附带40点穿透。
Adds 40 extra Penetration when dealing damage to hypnotized enemies with Dream Dance.
塔西释放终极技能“永恒梦境”后获得急速提高至130点。
Gains 130 Haste after casting Eternal Dreamscape.
塔西每次参与击败敌方英雄额外获得一次“蝶梦穿梭”的释放次数。
Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or defeats an enemy.
塔西每次参与击败敌方非召唤物角色后，额外获得一次“蝶梦穿梭”的释放次数。
Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or defeats a non-summoned enemy.
